query.description: Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.
(Required) Website ID or IDs to query.
(Required) Number of minutes to look back at, between 1 and 2880.
Custom segment to filter the counters. Example: "referrerName==example.com" Supports AND (;) and OR (,) operators.
Optional columns to include, for example `visits` or `actions`.
Optional columns to omit from the response.

request.description: Returns simple live counters for visits over the last N minutes.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

Whether to flatten action details into the visit rows.
Whether to skip fetching action details for better performance.
Whether plugins should enrich the returned visit details.
